title: Prior and later summer rain slopes did not differ clearly for beech-larch spring gaps in four Swiss samples, 1961-2020
abstract: We tested whether lower rainfall in the prior summer had a different link from later rainfall to the beech-minus-larch spring date gap. We used 4,450 paired records at 94 Swiss stations in two regions and two periods from 1961 to 2020. Each model controlled station, trend, spring temperature and summer temperature. All four adjusted intervals for the prior-minus-later July-August rainfall slope included zero. These data did not establish a distinct prior-summer rainfall link. This does not show that drought has no carry-over effect. Coarse rainfall is not soil drought. Missing visits, selected stations, correlated weather and 30 years per fit limit inference. Code, aggregate results, a figure, source hashes and external-data retrieval instructions are included.
